domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through approval/rejection to cancellation.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — request created but not yet submitted; editable by employee
SUBMITTED — request submitted and awaiting manager review
UNDER_REVIEW — manager has acknowledged and is evaluating the request
APPROVED — manager has approved the leave; balance consumed
REJECTED — manager has denied the leave; balance released
CANCELLED — employee cancelled the request; only allowed before the start date

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
attributes: code: string (enum key — ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY)
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type carries rules about documentation requirements and maximum consecutive days.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — leave type is available for use
DEPRECATED — leave type is no longer available for new requests but historical data retained

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and pending usage for a specific leave type within a defined period (typically annual).
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect and can be consumed
EXHAUSTED — balance has reached zero for the period
FROZEN — balance is temporarily unavailable (e.g., during investigation)

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules governing a specific leave type — entitlement, carry-forward limits, notice periods, and approval requirements. Policies are versioned by effective dates.
lifecycle_states: SUPERSEDED — replaced by a newer version; retained for historical reference
REVOKED — policy is no longer in effect

domain_entities.name: LeaveStatus
attributes: value: string (DRAFT | SUBMITTED | UNDER_REVIEW | APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED)
domain_entities.purpose: Value object representing the current state of a LeaveRequest. Drives all state transition validation.

business_rules: BR-001 — Leave Balance Sufficiency: A LeaveRequest may only be submitted if the employee's LeaveBalance for that leave type has sufficient remaining days (entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays >= totalDays requested).
BR-002 — No Overlapping Leaves: An employee cannot have two LeaveRequests in SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, or APPROVED status whose date ranges overlap.

BR-003 — Minimum Notice Period: A LeaveRequest must be submitted at least N calendar days before the startDate, where N is defined by LeavePolicy.minNoticeDays for the leave type. Emergency leave is exempt from this rule.
